verdict.rationale: Vercel's AI Gateway (vercel-docs-2) offers 'hundreds of models through one endpoint with budgets, fallbacks, and monitoring,' matching the single-call, no-GPU-management story, and Vercel's Functions/edge network implies global execution. However, there's no explicit evidence of global inference routing or capacity-planning abstraction beyond the gateway's endpoint claim, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific capability.
